phrases.phrase: On the public side, show sponsors from Setup → Advertising at position Container breadcrumb (top): Above (container_breadcrumb_top_above) using the copy line on Appearance → Sponsor banners. The Sponsor banners widget is for options only; leave its “Display in positions” empty unless you intentionally want extra placements. Advanced: <xf:macro template="bar_sb_public_macros" name="carousel" arg-banners="{$banners}" /> if you already have $banners.
Limits how wide each banner image can appear (the file on disk is unchanged). Use 0 for no limit. Typical values: 300–600.
Single matches the old BAR sponsor ad: one sponsor at a time, rotating. All lists every active banner in order.
HTTPS link to the banner image. If set, it is used for display instead of an uploaded file. You can still upload a fallback image.
Upload a JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP file. You must provide either an image URL or an upload (or both; the URL is shown when set).
Provide an image URL or upload a banner image.
The image URL must start with http:// or https://.
Warning: the image URL could not be fetched ({message}). It may still work in browsers; consider uploading a copy if it fails for guests.
Warning: the image URL could not be verified from the server. Consider uploading a copy if it does not load for everyone.
Warning: the remote host returned 401/403 (hotlink protection). The image may not load for guests; consider uploading a copy.
Warning: the image URL returned HTTP {code}. Consider uploading a copy if the image does not appear.
Warning: the URL did not look like an image response. Consider uploading a file instead.
Warning: the server did not send an image Content-Type; the file may still display in browsers.
Optional cap on how wide this banner can render (0 = no extra cap beyond the widget). Typical sponsor sizes are a few hundred pixels so the page is not dominated.
Optional max height (0 = none). Use with max width to keep logos readable.
Banners are ordered automatically: new ones are added at the end, and the list is renumbered when one is deleted. You do not need to set display order yourself.
Show this banner on the forum (sponsor widget)
Turn this off to hide the banner from the sponsor area without deleting it. You can turn it back on anytime.
This banner is now visible on the site.
This banner is now hidden from the site.
Link to sponsor website. Use a full URL (https://…) so the banner opens the right page when someone clicks it.
Short description for screen readers and when images do not load. Usually the sponsor or campaign name; it can match the title above.
To remove this banner permanently, use Delete. To pause it without losing settings, turn off “Show this banner on the forum” above or use Stop showing on the banner list.
Only when you change Advertising or the widget; ignore if things already work.
One place for sponsors — this page

Everything you add below is stored here. For the forum to show it, open Setup → Advertising → BAR Sponsors 2026, set Display position to Container breadcrumb (top): Above (inside the page container, directly above the top breadcrumb; XenForo id container_breadcrumb_top_above), delete all old sponsor code, paste the line in the gray box below, and save. Leave Appearance → Widgets → Sponsor banners with no display positions checked so banners appear only here (extra positions would duplicate them).
(Triple-click the box to select it, then copy.)
Open widget settings (where it appears on the page)

Click the button once to create it (optional but recommended so you can tune rotation and max width in one place). After it exists, leave “Display in positions” empty so ads show only from Advertising at Container breadcrumb (top): Above. The gray line above still works without any widget positions checked.
This uses the add-on’s internal name so it always works from Advertising — even when the widget has no “Display in positions” checked (the old key=… line fails in that case).
